scripts/check-evidence-probes.sh does cd "$(dirname $0)/.." at line 95, so a copy of it run from outside scripts/ silently resolves specs/evidence against the wrong root and reports FAIL (missing: ...) for every wired probe. Cost one wasted full gate run during the compile-verify measurement; fixed by placing the trial copy inside scripts/ instead.
